claim: The Amazon Cognito user pools SKU and Essentials SKU are free for the first 10,000 MAUs (users who sign in directly or through a social identity provider). Customers with existing user pools created on or before 10:00am Pacific Time, November 22, 2024 keep a free tier of the first 50,000 MAUs.

qualifiers.scope: per month per account or per AWS organization; user pools (Lite) and Essentials SKUs
qualifiers.condition: 50,000 MAUs only for user pools created on or before 10:00am PT, November 22, 2024

evidence.quote: Yes, the Amazon Cognito user pools SKU and Essentials SKU are free for the first 10,000 MAUs.

For users who sign in directly via Amazon Cognito or through a social identity provider, Amazon Cognito user pools has a free tier of 10,000 monthly active user (MAU) per month per account or per AWS organization.
Customers with existing user pools created on or before 10:00am Pacific Time, November 22, 2024 will continue having a free tier of first 50,000 MAUs.
